name: What is the process for beginning a garage-to-home office conversion with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for beginning a garage-to-home office conversion with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for a garage-to-home office conversion begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your vision, functional requirements, and existing garage conditions. Following this, our integrated design-build team develops detailed plans, including CAD-supported layouts, material selections, and a transparent project estimate. Once approved, we handle all permit coordination, construction management, and continuous communication through to the final walkthrough. This managed process provides a single point of coordination, simplifying complex projects for homeowners.
